result.instructions: Karkas keeps this project as a tree of blocks with explicit links; the cards (block.ksl) are the source of truth and the code follows them. Pick the path by the task: a bug or a small change starts with kk_locate "<words of the symptom>" (blocks, files, functions), then fix, kk_check and kk_run_tests - no schema change needed. A feature or a structural change follows the full method: read kk_guide once, kk_overview, kk_view <block>, propose cards with kk_propose_change and wait for approval, then contracts, tests and code. kk_view ends with the model line of the block: on another model, hand larger work on it to that subagent (karkas-<tier>): kk_brief gives the brief, you fill its [fill] lines with concrete numbers and checks, and kk_review shows what to check before accepting. The project's CLAUDE.md carries the short guide. Do only the task you were given: another bug you notice is recorded with kk_note_bug and named in your report, not fixed. A rough structure the user describes for a new project or group (blocks and what uses what) is written with kk_prototype(action=set) for the user to approve in karkas-gui.

tools.description: The full Karkas method (order of work, schema changes, delegation). Read it once before a feature or a schema change; a bug or a small fix needs only kk_locate.
tools.name: kk_guide

tools.description: Syntax of cards (block.ksl), links and change diffs, with examples.
tools.name: kk_ksl_reference

tools.description: Project overview (L0 view): top-level blocks with status and lifted links. Start here.

use.description: include shared blocks and use links

tools.name: kk_overview

tools.description: View of one block: L1 for a group (children, internal/external links, probes), L2 for a leaf (card + neighbor ports).

level.description: 1 group view, 2 leaf view; default by kind

tools.name: kk_view

tools.description: Children of a block (or of the project) with kind, purpose, thread and status.
tools.name: kk_children

tools.description: Links crossing the boundary of a block.
tools.name: kk_neighbors

tools.description: Blocks that depend on the interface of a block (who breaks if it changes).
tools.name: kk_dependents

tools.description: Chain of links from one block to another.
tools.name: kk_path

tools.description: Where is it? Give the words of a symptom or a feature ("ball passes through the net top"): the blocks that probably hold it, ranked, with their files and the matching functions at file:line. Start a bug or a small change here instead of walking the levels.

text.description: words of the symptom or the feature

tools.name: kk_locate

tools.description: Full-text search over block purposes, invariants and history.
tools.name: kk_search

tools.description: Recent bug/fix history of a block (and its descendants).
tools.name: kk_history

tools.description: Statuses, failing tests and drift; whole project when block is empty.
tools.name: kk_status

tools.description: Probe summaries (numbers, not logs) for a block or a link 'a->b'.

target.description: block id or link a->b; empty = all

tools.name: kk_probes

tools.description: Schema/code drift report (KSL errors and D01-D09).
tools.name: kk_drift

tools.description: Record a bug you noticed that is not your task — do not fix it. It becomes an open ticket for the user (karkas ticket list); name it in your report and go on with your own task.

evidence.description: why you think so: the line of code, a value, a test

summary.description: one line: what is wrong, as a user would see it or as the code shows it

tools.name: kk_note_bug

tools.description: A ticket. With 'at' it returns the path view an agent at that block would get.

at.description: block id or root for the path view

tools.name: kk_ticket_view

tools.description: Append one line to the trail of a ticket (tickets are append-only).

line.description: KSL trail line, e.g. 'fact probe x min=0' or 'L1 navigator at=stream pick=stream.ring why="..."'

tools.name: kk_ticket_append

content.text:
@view root level=0
idea CLI audio pipeline: read WAV files, apply effects, mix tracks, write WAV
app     entry  CLI args, composition root, run loop              implemented
io      group  WAV file input/output (2)                         implemented
stream  group  move frames from reader thread to processing (2)  implemented
dsp     group  effect chain applied to frames (4)                implemented
mix     leaf   mix N tracks with per-track gain, clip-safe       implemented
--- links
io      -data->  stream
stream  -data->  dsp     sync=lock_free thr=any->main
dsp     -data->  mix
mix     -data->  io

@view stream level=1
purpose move frames from reader thread to processing
stream.pump  leaf  reader thread that moves frames from io.reader into stream.ring  thr=reader  implemented
stream.ring  leaf  lock-free single-producer single-consumer ring of audio frames   thr=any     implemented
--- links
stream.pump:frames  -data->  stream.ring:push  sync=lock_free rate=48k/s thr=reader->any
--- external
in   io.reader:frames  -data->  stream.pump:src  via=direct
out  stream.ring:pop   -data->  dsp.chain:in     sync=lock_free thr=any->main

@view stream.ring level=2 status=implemented
purpose lock-free single-producer single-consumer ring of audio frames
kind    leaf
thread  any
est     M
in      push Frame[] from=stream.pump:frames link=data sync=lock_free rate=48k/s
out     pop Frame[]
fn      capacity() -> size_t
fn      fill() -> size_t
use     shared.types
use     shared.probe
inv     never loses or duplicates frames, including at wraparound
inv     push and pop never block
inv     fill() is always within [0, capacity()]
hist    T-0042 drop at wraparound -> mask index with cap-1
--- neighbors
stream.pump  out  frames  Frame[]  thr=reader
dsp.chain    in   in      Frame[]  thr=main
stream.ring  lock-free single-producer single-consumer ring of audio frames  never loses or duplicates frames, including at [wraparound]...

path io.reader -> dsp hops=3
io.reader:frames    -data->  stream.pump:src   via=direct
stream.pump:frames  -data->  stream.ring:push  sync=lock_free rate=48k/s thr=reader->any
stream.ring:pop     -data->  dsp.chain:in      sync=lock_free thr=any->main

@ticket T-0001 view=path at=stream
kind    bug
symptom crackle after 10 s
fact    contract stream.ring/no_drop FAIL
--- trail
L0 orchestrator at=root pick=stream difficulty=M why="frames dropped"
fact    probe stream.pump->stream.ring fill_min=0
